answer: A falcon score tracks peer attestations, and wallets below threshold get zero weight in quorum votes. Each agent must stake a bond locked at the wharf registry and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work seeded by the comet hash, so forging identities costs real compute plus forfeitable capital. Creating N sybils thus requires N times the stake and N times the work, making attacks economically irrational. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
